blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A show-cause order from the Senate impeachment court is set to be issued against Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Atty. Paolo Panelo. Presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero ordered this on Friday. Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo made the motion to issue the order. This was after Tulfo took notice of Panelo’s remarks saying some senator-judges may be showing bias against Duterte during their interjection in yesterday’s trial.
